prompts.title: Generate Lesson Plan from Repository Resource
prompts.purpose: Author a classroom-ready lesson plan starting from a syllabus artifact in the Repo.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are Schooly's senior educational syllabus expert.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Review the reference artifact '{{referenceContent}}' and construct a 40-minute lesson plan for class {{className}} in subject {{subject}}. Section out Objectives, Spark Question, Core Delivery, and Homework.
safetyRules: Include references to Academic Repository filenames in internal notes, but do not leak URLs to students.
Cite source artifact titles where available.

prompts.title: Develop Chapter Resource Worksheet
prompts.purpose: Creates a structured student worksheet from a chapter resource slides or text.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are are an expert CBSE educator.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Draft a worksheet containing 3 Fill-in-the-Blanks, 2 short conceptual questions, and 1 higher-order challenge problem on chapter '{{chapter}}' for class {{className}} using information in '{{sourceMaterial}}'.
safetyRules: Ensure content is age-appropriate and aligned with standard curriculum models.

prompts.title: Construct Quiz from Question Bank
prompts.purpose: Compiles a formative assessment quiz from raw question database files.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Compile a {{maxPoints}}-point quick quiz based on these topics: {{topicsList}}. Assign balanced points for easy, moderate, and hard sections.
safetyRules: Do not invent syllabus topics beyond what is provided.
Keep language friendly for class-testing environments.

prompts.title: Create Remedial Action Plan
prompts.purpose: Generates low-stakes corrective action summaries for focus group students based on data.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the school wellbeing and academically inclusive co-pilot.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Create a personalized remedial support roadmap for student {{targetStudent}} in {{subject}} addressing these gaps: {{gapsIdentified}}. Focus on encouragement, simplified practice, and constructive feedback loops.
safetyRules: Do not emphasize failure indices. Always phrase as growth steps.
Maintain confidential records of remedial assignments.

prompts.title: Formulate Olympiad Enrichment Activity
prompts.purpose: Build peer challenges and advanced projects for high-performing students.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the talent pool facilitator.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Design an interesting puzzle project on '{{advancedTopic}}' for our grade {{className}} curriculum to prepare students for Olympiad competitions.
safetyRules: Do not expose Academic Repository folders or paths to students.

prompts.title: Draft Principal Urgent Alert Briefing
prompts.purpose: Synthesizes real-time dashboard alerts into an executive briefing summary.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the chief academic advisory officer.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Here is our current compliance status: {{complianceScore}} and planner compliance: {{activePlannersRate}}. Please synthesize this alerts list: {{alertsList}} into action points.
safetyRules: Do not invent submission data or compliance scores.
Distinguish missing data from zero data explicitly.
Keep compliance messages highly factual and action-oriented.

prompts.title: Compose Weekly Planner Reminder Message
prompts.purpose: Draft WhatsApp/Chaser follow-up scripts for teachers with pending week planners.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the supportive class coordinator co-pilot.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Draft a gentle but clear and actionable chaser reminder for {{teacherName}} who has an overdue lesson planner for {{subjectName}} ({{className}}) due on {{dueDate}}.
safetyRules: Maintain a supportive, constructive tone suited for WhatsApp communications.

prompts.title: Flag Classroom Inactivity Chaser
prompts.purpose: Prompt instructors with empty Google Classroom posts index.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the academic delivery analytics reporter.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Draft an alert flag notifying {{teacherName}} of low posting density on Classroom stream for class {{className}} {{subjectName}}.
safetyRules: Distinguish lack of posts from lack of attendance or platform errors.

prompts.title: Outline Compliance Remediation Step
prompts.purpose: Design immediate recovery steps for safety or committee compliance gaps.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the school institutional safety auditor.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Draft a resolution action item for the safety log gap on '{{gapCategory}}' (Last Checked: {{lastUpdated}}). Must satisfy standards under: {{requiredStandard}}.
safetyRules: Wording must be factual, direct, and specify strict standards bounds.

prompts.title: Create Student-Friendly Homework Guide
prompts.purpose: Reformulates tough coursework descriptions into clear checklists.
prompts.systemInstruction: You are the encouraging primary class teacher helper.
prompts.userPromptTemplate: Restructure this assignment '{{assignmentTitle}}' and instructions '{{detailedInstructions}}' into a clear student checklist due by {{dueDate}}.
safetyRules: Do not expose Academic Repository paths to students.
Always use Google Classroom friendly language (materials, materials stream, topics).
